title: Detent Engage — partner programme
reader: The owner of a web agency or IT reseller who already builds and hosts client websites.
reaction: I already have the client list. I have been giving away the only part that keeps paying.
model: The partner installs and looks after the client. Detent contracts with, invoices and runs the platform for the client. The partner earns a margin on the customer's monthly or annual spend, for as long as that customer is paying and the partner is in the programme.
note: No commission percentage is stated anywhere in this cut, on purpose: the published rate on the marketing site and the default bands in packages/reseller/src/bands.ts do not agree, and a film is the worst place to settle that. State the shape of the deal, never the number.

beats.big:
A website is a project.
A project ends.
beats.small: The day it goes live it stops earning. For your client, and for you.

beats.big:
You build it. You host it.
You get the call when it breaks.
beats.small: You have never once been paid twice for it.

beats.lower: Detent Engage. One script tag, on a site you already maintain.
That is the whole integration. No tag manager, no data layer.
It qualifies before it answers. No deflection, no calendar link.
It quotes your client's published band — and refuses a bespoke figure.
It will not invent what it has no authority to give.
It tells every visitor it is AI, before anything else.
It asks before it identifies anyone, and enrols nobody in marketing.

beats.big:
You install.
We contract, invoice and run it.
beats.small: Their commercial risk sits with us. Their relationship stays with you.

beats.big:
You earn a margin on
what that client spends.
beats.small: Monthly or annually, whichever way they buy.
A margin on their spend, for as long as they are a paying customer and you are a partner.

beats.big:
The tenth site you install
is still paying you in year three.
beats.small: While you are installing the fortieth.

beats.lower: One product. Every client you already look after.

beats.small: Partner programme. You already have the client list.
